title: Manager - Intelligent Process Platform
highlights: Agentic AI enablement: Conducted Agentic AI enabler sessions for team members across IPP, building practical skills in UiPath agents, MCP Servers, and agentic design patterns. Followed up with a 15-day agent-build challenge to turn learning into hands-on builds.

Agentic AI PoCs: Designed and built agentic AI proofs of concept, including a conversational Orchestrator management agent on a Coded MCP Server architecture and an intelligent invoice processing agent with human-in-the-loop validation, to show clients the value of next-generation automation.

Intelligent automation: Integrated Document Understanding, AI Center, and GenAI/LLM capabilities to automate unstructured document processing such as invoices and claims, reaching higher extraction accuracy.

Agentic automation: Architected agentic workflows that combine UiPath Agents, Maestro, and API integrations, moving clients from rule-based bots to [AI-driven decisioning or human-in-the-loop] orchestration.

Platform and infrastructure: Planned and administered Orchestrator and Automation Cloud environments, including license optimization, bot scheduling, credential vaults, and high-availability setup for unattended robots.
Governance and CoE: Set up or strengthened the Automation CoE with coding standards, reusable component libraries, a design-review gate, and monitoring dashboards, cutting defect leakage.

Integration: Built integrations with SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Oracle, mainframe, and REST/SOAP APIs, using API-first approaches where possible to make bots more resilient.
Hypercare and support: Established production support processes with SLA-based incident handling, exception analytics, and bot health monitoring, keeping bot uptime highest.
